lines: Ride on consecutive days and your streak grows. The backend keeps it, so every screen agrees.
Each calendar day with a finished ride adds one, in your own time zone. A second ride that day doesn't count twice. Miss a whole day and it's back to zero.
The streak pays: ten XP a day on every ride, in the same number the header shows.
The flame and the count sit in the header, and Profile reads seven hundred sixty XP to level eight, four-day streak. No streak, no flame.
What the tests prove: every case of the rule, the streak through the API across midnight, and the header and Profile.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
